_note: Manual metric overrides, keyed by slug. Wins over synced + authored at render time. check-drift.js NEVER writes this file on --update; it reads it only to flag stale baselines, and writes it only on the explicit `bun run drift:accept`. Per field: value = what is shown; syncedWhenSet = the synced value at the moment the override was set; syncedField = the underlying synced field to compare against (defaults to the field name; only `commits` ever needs this, e.g. `commitsMine` for a team project). The drift report flags a field when current synced !== syncedWhenSet. Run `bun run drift:accept -- <slug> <field>` to refresh the baseline and dismiss the flag while keeping your manual value.
